references.text: Describes Jesus' activity of teaching, preaching, and healing, which parallels the activities mentioned in Matthew 9:35.
Micah's prophecy about a ruler from Bethlehem who will arise and shepherd his people can be seen in light of Jesus' ministry and proclamation of God's kingdom as mentioned in Matthew 9:35.
Luke also describes how Jesus went from town to town preaching the good news of God's kingdom, paralleling the description in Matthew 9:35.
John describes Jesus' healing ministry, which aligns with what Matthew reports in 9:35 about Jesus healing every disease and sickness.
